key_components.use_feed_data: app/hooks/useFeedData.ts (city+district+price+type state, API fetch with city param, 15s polling)
key_components.mobile_profile_sheet: app/components/profile/MobileProfileSheet.tsx (mobile bottom sheet - tap tab Cá nhân)
key_components.profile_tabs: app/components/profile/ProfileTabs.tsx (tabs: Tin đăng | Đã lưu | Thành tích)
key_components.profile_header: app/components/profile/ProfileHeader.tsx (Client Component - inline edit form, isEditing state, PATCH /api/me)
key_components.profile_page: app/(main)/profile/page.tsx (Server Component - fetches data, passes to ProfileHeader)

api_endpoints.explained: Lấy danh sách tin đăng. Nhận city param để lọc server-side. district/price filter ở client.
Lấy thông tin profile của user đang login: { user, profile, stats }. 401 nếu guest.
Cập nhật displayName, phone, avatarUrl của user hiện tại.
Điểm xu, level, streak, rank của user.
Danh sách huy hiệu đã đạt của user.
Toggle quan tâm (interested) cho một intent. Body: { id, increment: boolean }.

auth_gate_pattern.method: requireAuth(fn) — shows modal for guests, calls fn for logged-in users

patterns: Click-to-Gate: guest users see all content but are prompted to login on interaction
SocialPostCard: hero image full-width → PostHeader → PostBody w/ AI highlights → BotPreview → ReactionSummary → ActionBar 3-btn
AI highlight: PRICE_RE highlights prices in indigo bold, PLACE_RE underlines locations
FeedTab: vipIntents (isVip=true, top 5 by match_count) + regularIntents (all, with vip IDs excluded) → deduplicated allFeedIntents single-col list
Hybrid Profile: Desktop = ProfileDropdown từ TopNavbar → /profile page (Option C). Mobile = MobileProfileSheet từ BottomNavMobile tab Cá nhân (Option D)
City filter: server-side by city param; district/price filter is client-side on fetched data
gotchas: VN admin reform 2025: No more districts, only Tỉnh/TP → Phường/Xã
Default tab in app/page.tsx must be 'home' (not 'swipe') for guest UX
SocialPostCard uses Image from next/image for hero (requires unoptimized for external URLs)
MobileProfileSheet state quản lý riêng (không dùng activeTab) để tránh xung đột routing BottomNavMobile
FeedTab: must deduplicate vipIntents from regularIntents before merging to avoid duplicate React keys
FeedFilterDrawer is rendered inside overflow-y-auto container but uses fixed positioning — works correctly in browser
conventions: Components: named exports, TSX, Tailwind classes inline
CITY_DISTRICTS map in FeedFilterSidebar.tsx, exported getDistrictsForCity(city) helper
VIP threshold: match_count > 0 OR trust_score >= 4, top 5 shown with Premium badge
